text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on modeling the current and future distribution of the camel tick Hyalomma dromedarii using MaxEnt. Although it uses land use/land cover (LULC) as one of several environmental input variables—contributing 53.1% to model performance—it does not predict or simulate future LULC changes. Instead, LULC is treated as a static input derived from ESA CCI for 2020 and excluded entirely in future climate projections (ssp2-4.5 for 2040/2060). The primary objective is species distribution modeling, not LULC prediction. The study fails core inclusion criteria: (1) no LULC prediction/simulation is performed; (2) future scenarios do not include projected LULC layers; (3) outputs are tick habitat suitability maps, not mapped LULC projections. It meets exclusion criterion “Species-specific/ecological focus unrelated to LULC” and “No LULC prediction component.”)
